messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@greenlane.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Sutherland <tom.sutherland@cloudbank.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Request: rate adjustment + split SOW for phased rollout

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our execs greenlit an increase in committed throughput for Q3, but procurement needs an updated commercial showing:
- an incremental capacity line item (50% add-on)
- a one-time implementation milestone tied to staggered rollout (pilot -> stage -> prod)
- a clear fee schedule for months 1-6 vs month 7+

We'd like Redwood to propose a change order + a matching SOW that splits deliverables into Phase A (pilot) and Phase B (full rollout). Procurement also flagged they want the PO to reference an active order form and (if possible) a short-term price cap for 12 months.

Can you send a draft change order and SOW split we can circulate? Attaching the internal procurement checklist for reference.

Thanks,
Olivia
Procurement Manager
GreenLane AI

Attachments: GreenLane_procurement_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 02:11:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Request: rate adjustment + split SOW for phased rollout

Olivia — appreciate the clear ask. Quick answers:
- We can add an incremental committed throughput SKU for the 50% top-up and show both a monthly and effective per-token blended rate.
- We can produce a change order that references the existing Order Form (OF-GL-4827) and append a two-exhibit SOW (Phase A / Phase B).
- Short-term price cap: we can offer a 12-month price protection on the new SKU, subject to a minimum monthly commitment. Will flag exact thresholds in the draft.

Jordan — looping you in to prepare the draft change order and a phased SOW. Karthik, please advise on any legal must-haves for the SOW split (termination mechanics, rollback window, SLA carve-outs during pilot).

I'll aim to get a first draft over by end of day Monday — would that work for your review cycle?

Best,
Vivek
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Subject: Draft: proposed change order + MAP for Phased SOW (attached)

Hi Olivia — attaching a working draft of the change order and a phased SOW (v1). Key notes up front:
- Change order adds "Committed Add-On: 50% Additional Throughput" as Exhibit A with line-item pricing and an implementation credit for a pilot that converts to production.
- SOW split: Phase A (8-week pilot) with acceptance criteria and limited SLA; Phase B (full rollout) with full SLA and capacity ramp schedule.
- Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) included on page 2 of the DOCX: approvals, security review, PO issuance, and implementation window.

Ask: please review redlines for price tiers and confirm procurement's preferred acceptance criteria for pilot -> prod conversion (automated perf checks vs manual sign-off). If procurement prefers DocuSign, we can prepare that envelope — I included a placeholder link in Related Links.

Attachments: proposed-change-order-v1.docx (change order + SOW)

Subject: RE: Draft: proposed change order + MAP for Phased SOW (attached)

Thanks for the draft — I reviewed and left line comments in the DOCX. Main legal items to resolve before we circulate to procurement: 
1) Term alignment: the change order should explicitly state whether the added SKU inherits the remaining term of the original Order Form or starts a new 12-month term. I recommend inheriting remaining term with a 12-month minimum thereafter.
2) Termination and rollback: add a 30-day pilot rollback window post-acceptance where GreenLane can revert to prior capacity levels without early termination fees (qualified by traffic baselines).
3) SLA and credits: Phase A should have limited uptime SLA and an "exercise-of-good-faith" clause for performance tuning; Phase B retains standard SLA. Any credits should be capped to a fixed % of monthly fees for the pilot period.
4) Data handling & audit logs: procurement requested clarification — include an exhibit referencing the active SOC2 report and a link to our audit-log export process.

I also suggested a short implementation acceptance checklist as an exhibit to avoid ambiguous "manual sign-offs." Jordan/Laura — if you can incorporate my redlines I can take a final pass and sign off for legal.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We reviewed the change order with procurement and legal. Good news: procurement will issue a PO referencing your Order Form and the attached SOW split, provided the following are updated in the final doc:
- Clarify that the added SKU inherits the existing order term and that the 12-month price protection begins on the effective date of the change order.
- Include Karthik's rollback window language for the pilot and the acceptance checklist exhibit.

Attached is PO #4827 (signed). We still want the finalized change order/DocuSign envelope before we consider the PO binding to the change (procurement process). Please convert the attached DOCX to a DocuSign envelope with the redlines applied and send back for signature.

Attachments: GreenLane_PO_4827.pdf (purchase order)

Best,
Olivia Park
